coreFields.groom: Khmer groom full name (e.g. ជា វណ្ណដា)
coreFields.bride: Khmer bride full name (e.g. សុខ ស្រីពេជ្រ)
coreFields.groomParents: Full parents blessing string or separate father/mother fields
coreFields.brideParents: Full parents blessing string or separate father/mother fields
coreFields.targetDate: ISO 8601 target datetime string for countdown

venue.name: Hall or venue display name
venue.mapLink: Google Maps URL or embedded maps link

coreFields.schedule: Array of ceremony items with time, title, optional description and location
coreFields.programDays: Structured multi-day ceremonies array for complex Khmer weddings
coreFields.gallery: Array of photo image URLs or media objects
coreFields.gift: QR code URL and bank account payment metadata
coreFields.rsvp: Host-configured guest RSVP responses with attending count and food/wishes
coreFields.enabledSections: Boolean dictionary toggling countdown, schedule, map, gallery, gift, rsvp, dressCode, story
